Proof of Work

Real contributions to the open hardware and RISC-V ecosystem.

cva6

openhwgroup

The CORE-V CVA6 is a highly configurable, 6-stage RISC-V core for both application and embedded applications. Application class configurations are capable of booting Linux.

Open GitHub

riscv-iommu

zero-day-labs

An open-source RTL implementation of the RISC-V IOMMU specification, providing DMA address translation and isolation for I/O devices.

Open GitHub

riscv-aia

zero-day-labs

An implementation of the RISC-V Advanced Interrupt Architecture (AIA), bringing MSI-based and wired interrupt delivery (IMSIC and APLIC) to RISC-V platforms.

Open GitHub

riscv-iopmp

zero-day-labs

A hardware implementation of the RISC-V IOPMP specification, enforcing physical memory access control for DMA-capable bus masters.
